Introduction

Yoon Suho, formerly known as Seungyeop, is a South Korean singer. He is a former member of the boy group E'LAST and its sub-unit E'LAST U.

He was oficialy announced as a member of E Entertainment's boy group on August 21, 2019. Then known as EBOYZ, the group named was changed to E'LAST, with the group making their official debut on June 9, 2020 with the mini album "Day Dream".

In January 2023, Seungyeop began his mandatory military service. Although he was discharged in July 2024, E Ent remained silent about his status, only acknowledging him publicly on his birthday. On June 20, 2025, Seungyeop posted a photo on his personal Instagram with the caption "fresh start." Two days later, he held a live stream where he confirmed that his exclusive contract with E Ent had ended and that he was no longer a member of E'LAST. Despite this, he reassured fans of his intention to pursue various solo activities. As of yet, E Ent has not released an official statement. He later changed his stage name to Yoon Suho in August 2025.
